## Exercise 8.1

```{python}
import subprocess

for i in [1, 2, 3]:
    name = f"OpenCL-helloworld-{i}"
    subprocess.run(
        ["g++", f"{name}.cpp", "-o", name, "-lOpenCL"], check=True
    )
    result = subprocess.run(
        [f"./{name}"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
    )
    print(name)
    print(result.stdout)
```
